title: Working parents workshop on the sandwich generation
discussion_signal: The workshop frames sandwich-generation caregiving as a problem of being stretched and short on time while supporting children and older relatives. It presents discussion and planning as a way to handle competing care demands.
linked_research_question: Whether support and coordination can return practical time to people carrying child and eldercare responsibilities at once.
limits: Institutional workshop framing rather than a sampled caregiver discussion
The video page does not establish attendance or outcomes
Support advice does not prove that time or work consequences were reversed
